''R6'' - RoseHere |rarity = {{Color|Common}} |looped = Yes |music = Yes |moveable = No |interactable = No |oldmusic = '''Version 1''' [[File:(Official) Tower Defense Simulator OST - Power Dance|250px|thumb|center]] |newmusic = '''Version 2''' [[File:(Official) Tower Defense Simulator OST - Breakdown|thumb|center|250px]] }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|Goes with any song!|Inventory Description}} {{QuoteBox|Breakdown|Former Inventory Description}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''Breakdown''' is an [[Emotes|emote]] that is bundled with the Meme Emotes gamepass which can be bought for {{Robux|55}}. It was made by RoseHere. The emote is looped and music can be heard while performing the emote. You cannot move while performing this emote. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Previous Animations}} Breakdown.gif|First version (13 October 2019 – 29 October 2020) }} ==Trivia== *This [[Emotes|emote]] was based on an emote with the [[w:c:Fornite:Breakdown|same name]] from the game ''Fortnite'', where it was the Tier 95 item in its Season 5 Battle Pass. *Part of the R6 version of '''Breakdown''' was formerly used by the Level 5 Default [[DJ Booth]]. *The original music that this emote used was shared with the [[Power Dance]] emote. ==Update History== *'''13 October 2019''' - [[Release v1.0|Release v1.0.0]] **'''Breakdown''' added. *'''9 November 2019''' - [[Release v1.2|Release v1.2.0]] **Music added. *'''26 January 2020''' - [[Release v1.6|Release v1.6.1]] **Music replaced. *'''29 October 2020''' - [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul v1.0.0]] **Animation replaced. **Now obtained from the Meme Emotes gamepass ({{Robux|200}}) instead of costing {{Robux|100}}. *'''22 March 2022''' - [[v1.1.0]]e **Music removed. *'''7 June 2022''' - [[v1.2.4]]c **Music re-added. *'''24 February 2024''' - [[v1.14.0]] **Cost decreased from {{Robux|200}} to {{Robux|100}}. *'''23 May 2024''' - [[v1.23.0]] **Cost decreased from {{Robux|100}} to {{Robux|70}}. *'''2 August 2026''' - [[v2.4.0|v2.4.2a]] **Cost decreased from {{Robux|70}} to {{Robux|55}}. {{EmoteNavBox}}
